S187TM.Settings.GrantOwnershipHint: When a rider mounts, give that rider's owners ownership of the mount so they can pilot it directly. Foundry resolves token permission through the actor, so this also grants access to the mount's character sheet. Turn off to leave ownership untouched: a GM must then drive the mount, since Foundry will not let a player select a token they do not own. Riders are still carried automatically either way.
S187TM.Settings.MaxRidersHint: How many tokens may ride a single mount.
S187TM.Settings.DragToMountHint: Dragging a token onto a mountable token mounts it, with no need to target and use the HUD. Off by default, or walking a token across a stabled horse would put it in the saddle. Individual tokens can override this either way in Token Config.
S187TM.Settings.DetectMountsHint: Tokens are not mountable unless marked. When one is dropped on a scene, check its name against the list below and mark a match as mountable, so a horse is ridable the moment it lands. A token whose Can Be Mounted option has already been set either way is left alone.
S187TM.Settings.MountNamesHint: Comma-separated. Matched whole-word against the token and actor names, so "horse" does not fire on "Horseshoe Crab". Add your own; clearing this restores the defaults.
S187TM.Settings.HostileCheck: Hostile Mounts Require an Animal Handling Check
S187TM.Settings.HostileCheckHint: Riding a token hostile to the rider first requires a DC check to subdue it. Cancelling the roll counts as refusing to try.
S187TM.Settings.HostileDCHint: The DC to subdue a hostile mount.
S187TM.Settings.DebugHint: Log mounting and carrying decisions to the console.
S187TM.Config.CapacityHint: How many tokens may ride this one. Leave blank to use the world setting.
S187TM.Config.MountableHint: Whether this token may be ridden at all. Off by default: a token has to be marked as a mount, either here or automatically by name when it is created.
S187TM.Config.DragMountHint: Whether dragging a token onto this one mounts it. Overrides the world setting for this token only.
S187TM.Config.RideableHint: Whether this token may ride anything. Turn off for tokens that should never be passengers.
S187TM.Config.GrantModeHint: Whether mounting this token gives the rider's owners control of it. Overrides the world setting for this token only.
S187TM.Dnd5e.Refused: The mount throws you off — you failed to subdue it.
S187TM.Steer.Passenger: You are a passenger. Only the rider in the first seat can steer.
S187TM.HUD.TargetFirst: Target the token you want to ride first, then click Mount.
S187TM.Error.DifferentScene: Both tokens must be on the same scene.
S187TM.Error.AlreadyMounted: That token is already riding something. Dismount first.
S187TM.Error.Cycle: That would make two tokens ride each other.
S187TM.Error.Full: That mount has no free seats.
S187TM.Error.CannotSteer: You do not have control of that mount, so you cannot steer it.
S187TM.Error.Refused: That mount will not let you ride it.
S187TM.Error.NoGM: A GM must be online to mount or dismount.
S187TM.Error.NoCarryAction: Token Mounting: the carry movement action could not be registered, so riders will snap to position instead of travelling with their mount.
